accepted.quote: The critical minerals and critical materials lists provide important strategic direction for decision-makers to prioritize government actions and investments to secure vulnerable mineral and materials supply chains.
accepted.rationale: The quote endorses critical minerals lists as a tool to prioritize actions to secure supply chains.

accepted.quote: The Trump administration has blatantly violated the letter and spirit of the Energy Act of 2020 by including metallurgical coal and uranium in the final 2025 United States Geological Survey (USGS) critical minerals list at the direction of the President.
accepted.rationale: The quote opposes inclusion of metallurgical coal and uranium on the critical minerals list as a violation of the Energy Act.
